description: Market-neutral payroll. Statutory rules are tenant data (jurisdiction, components, brackets), not hardcoded country logic.

routes.POST /api/tenant/payroll/jurisdictions: Create a market profile: currency, exponent, identifier labels
routes.POST /api/tenant/payroll/components: Create a component and optional marginal brackets
routes.POST /api/tenant/payroll/engagements: Create salary, hourly, daily, or piece engagement
routes.POST /api/tenant/payroll/runs: Calculate slips with @dakinis/payroll. Refuses locked slips.
routes.POST /api/tenant/payroll/slips/:id/pay: Record a payment instruction, not a bank file (payroll.pay)

outOfScope: Filing payroll tax with an authority
Storing raw bank account numbers; use instrument_ref
